title: Transition networks from sequences
description: Relative (transition probability), frequency (transition count) and attention (decay-weighted) networks of 300 sequences over nine states, against tna::tna(), tna::ftna() and tna::atna(). Every non-zero edge is compared, self-transitions included; an edge that only one side has would show as missing.
